title: XPENG names robotaxi service XPENG YOYO, moves toward public trials
key_facts: XPENG named its robotaxi business XPENG YOYO on Thursday 8 Oct 2026.
It launched a ride-hailing mini program where members of the public can join testing with invitation codes.
By August it had completed more than 2,000 internal test rides in Guangzhou and obtained approval for road tests without a safety driver on designated roads.
The first production robotaxi, based on the GX model, rolled off the line in May 2026.
XPENG says it relies on cameras (vision) rather than HD maps or LiDAR, with four in-house Turing AI chips.
A dedicated robotaxi model is planned for 2027; CEO He Xiaopeng aims for per-vehicle profit in Guangzhou in the second half of 2027.
TechNode notes that invitation-only trials do not mean the service is fully open, and coverage, booking availability and hours remain to be seen.
quote_evidence: On Thursday, XPENG announced XPENG YOYO as the global brand name for its robotaxi business.
By August, XPENG had completed more than 2,000 internal test rides in Guangzhou and obtained approval to conduct road tests without a safety driver in the driver’s seat on designated roads.
However, invitation-only trials do not mean the service is fully open to the public.
why_it_matters_hint: Moves a major Chinese carmaker's robotaxi from internal tests to testing with outside users.
notes: Company claims on chips and vision approach are XPENG's own.
